narrativeProgression.description: The Speaker clarifies he doesn't oppose all dialogue but advocates for strong action against Boko Haram.
Speaker shares personal experience living in the north, challenges notions about northern people and Boko Haram.
Direct address to the audience, questioning actions of northern leaders who condone Boko Haram.
Argument that terrorism requires strength, not appeasement.
Prediction of further escalation if Boko Haram actions are ignored.
Criticism of president’s failed dialogues with Boko Haram.
Call for government support in fighting Boko Haram.
